item.title: Manasota Key Road reopens after 2024 hurricanes
item.description: Manasota Key Road reopened Saturday after it was washed out by hurricanes Helene and Milton in 2024.

item.title: Manatee County deputies help rescue shark tangled in fishing gear
item.description: A routine patrol off the Manatee County coastline turned into a marine rescue Friday when deputies spotted a shark tangled in fishing gear near the shoreline.

item.title: Cruise ship out of Florida hit by norovirus outbreak; 94 affected
item.description: A cruise ship that departed Florida has been hit by a norovirus outbreak, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

item.title: FDOT upgrading busy I-75 interchanges in North Port to ease traffic
item.description: Major changes are coming to some of North Port’s busiest Interstate 75 interchanges as the Florida Department of Transportation moves forward with projects aimed at reducing congestion during peak travel times.
